listings.remarks: Many vintage Chicago units have been remodeled with open floor plans. This one kept its rooms, featuring a spacious kitchen, dining room, and living room, with a bedroom and bath tucked away off the rear hall. The unit also retains original construction like true hardwood floors and plaster walls and ceilings, built with materials and skill that have outlasted much newer work.
